suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Repair the configured model string used for Task subagents launched by scrutiny so reviewer droids can be spawned instead of forcing manual review artifact generation.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Every attempted Task launch for `scrutiny-feature-reviewer` in this milestone failed immediately with `Invalid model: custom:GPT-5.4-Medium-[VibeProxy]-25`, so the validator had to create the per-feature review artifacts manually after validators passed.
